source: The CLI starts in the current directory and goes up through the parent directories. It stops at the first config file, or at the directory that holds {0}. Two options change the search:
text: CLI 从当前目录开始，逐级向上查找父目录。找到第一个配置文件，或到达包含 {0} 的目录时停止。有两个选项可以改变查找方式：
